properties.headline: High Surf Advisory issued July 29 at 3:14AM HST until July 29 at 6:00PM HST by NWS Honolulu HI
properties.description:
...HIGH SURF ADVISORY FOR EAST FACING SHORES THROUGH WEDNESDAY
AFTERNOON...

.East swell from Tropical Depression Fausto has fallen below
warning levels and will continue to rapidly decline today. By this
afternoon, surf is expected to diminish below advisory
thresholds as the depression continues to weaken.

* WHAT...Surf 8 to 12 ft in the morning, quickly diminishing below
10 ft by this afternoon.

* WHERE...East facing shores.

* WHEN...Until 6 PM HST this evening.

* IMPACTS...Moderate. Strong breaking waves and strong currents
will make swimming dangerous.
properties.instruction:
Heed all advice from ocean safety officials. When in doubt, don't
go out.
